title: I Let My Neighbor Keep the Drone Over My Yard Until the City Portal Logged It

parts.text: A quadcopter hung over my tomatoes at 6:18 p.m. Neighbor Craig said it was a hobby. The city portal said: NO HOVER OVER PRIVATE YARDS. REGISTERED NUMBERS VISIBLE. I was forty-four, gardener, holding a still of his N-number. I uploaded the still, the time, and the tomato rows. Craig called it air. Air is a word hobbies use when a portal exists. The portal mailed him. The drone now hovers over Craig's driveway. My tomatoes look like tomatoes, which is to say unfilmed. I go back to being a person with a receipt. The second photo is for the person who will say they never saw the first.

social.video_title: The hobby had an N-number over my tomatoes — Part 1/1
social.description: City portal, a still, a driveway hover. Has a neighbor ever called your yard air?
